positives.name: account-and-resume
positives._note: the desk's parser case: the iPhone app never sends account. account sits between model and parent_session_id, resume_session_id after parent_session_id

negatives.name: resume-stripped
negatives._note: an old desk rebuilds the body without resume_session_id: the resume's signature does not verify, so it answers bad_signature and starts nothing

negatives.name: resume-id-altered
negatives._note: a relay or a bug that swapped one session for another

negatives.name: resume-added
negatives._note: a new-session signature does not authorise a resume

negatives.name: resume-before-parent
negatives._note: a correct signature over a body in the wrong order: the desk rebuilds the canonical body and it differs

negatives.name: empty-resume-signed
negatives._note: resume_session_id is signed only when non-empty; a body carrying "" is never the canonical one

unchecked.grok:c8f3b0d5: Couldn't check whether Grok can resume. Try again.

resume_rules._rules: Each row is a phone resume that already passed frames-v4's checks (including unknown_cwd); expect is the first frames-v17 resume check that fails, or the first ok reply. `live` entries match on cli and id, never account. `unsupported` is help text read without the resume flag; `unchecked` is a probe that could not read the help. `roots` is the phone's browse scope, compared on whole path components. A field `account` absent means the desk's default.

cases.name: codex-ok
cases._note: then typed: the message was its resume prompt

cases.name: id-128
cases._note: 128 characters is the shape's limit and passes it; nothing has that id

cases.name: id-empty
cases._note: present but empty is not the shape; omitted is a plain launch

cases.name: codex-empty-message
cases._note: a phone's Codex resume carries its first message (11543)

cases.name: outside-roots
cases._note: the scope's code is unknown_resume, not forbidden_path (11543)

cases.name: scope-beats-live
cases._note: a0a0a0a0 is live, but outside the roots: the phone learns nothing, not even that it runs (11545)

cases.name: live-with-message
cases._note: ONE reply: nothing is typed into the running session (11545)

cases.name: live-beats-account
cases._note: a live id is answered before the account resolves; account is not compared

cases.name: live-beats-folder
cases._note: a running session is answered before its folder is compared

cases.name: live-other-cli
cases._note: 11111111-… is live as claude; asked as grok it is not running, and not in grok's index

cases.name: unknown-account
cases._note: the account resolves before the index, which is per account (11545)

cases.name: wrong-cli
cases._note: the id is a codex session, asked for as claude

cases.name: probe-unreadable
cases._note: a probe that could not read the help is not 'too old' (11545)

argv._rules: frames-v17 launch.argv: the arguments after the CLI's own binary, before any quoting. claude's message is typed after check-in and never in argv.
